title: When a Conceptor Complement Becomes Gain: Operator Geometry and Behavioral Attribution in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a steering intervention changes a language model's behavior, which part of the intervention deserves the credit? We test this question for a target-centered, scaled conceptor complement by removing its fitted covariance filter while preserving the same target-specific center and gain. At the original aperture $\alpha=.05$ and gain $\beta=2$, all 21 fitted maps across three models and seven targets expand every direction at the generation intervention layers. The matrix correction is $0.093\%$--$7.815\%$ of the matched-control displacement on held-out extraction activations. In 480 paired comparisons within a 1,920-response study, retaining the matrix changes many individual texts but does not establish a consistent additional target-suppression benefit on the four-target panel. translated_title: 当概念器补集成为增益：语言模型中的算子几何与行为归因
translated_abstract: 当一个引导干预改变了语言模型的行为时，干预中的哪个部分应当获得这份功劳？我们通过移除拟合的协方差滤波器、同时保留相同的目标特定中心与增益，对一种以目标为中心、带缩放的概念器补集进行了检验。在原始孔径 α=.05 和增益 β=2 下，三个模型、七个目标上的全部 21 个拟合映射在生成干预层处对每个方向均产生扩展。在留出的提取激活上，矩阵修正仅占匹配对照位移的 0.093%–7.815%。在一项包含 1,920 条响应的研究所进行的 480 组配对比较中，保留矩阵虽改变了许多单个文本，但在四目标评估面板上并未确立一致的额外目标抑制收益。几何孔径扫描表明，其运行状态随滤波器设置而变化。此外，一个可逆的软滤波器保留了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过消融实验发现，概念器补集引导干预对语言模型行为的改变主要来自目标特定的中心与增益（β=2 使所有方向扩展），而协方差矩阵修正的贡献仅占匹配对照位移的 0.093%–7.815%，且未带来一致的目标抑制额外收益，因此干预的功劳应主要归于增益项而非矩阵滤波器。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the behavioral effect of a conceptor-complement steering intervention is driven mainly by the target-specific center and gain (β=2 expands all directions), while the covariance-matrix correction contributes only 0.093%–7.815% of matched-control displacement and yields no consistent additional target-suppression benefit.
